verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say it pays both employees and contractors in a single system (worldwide), alongside US payroll tax calculation and filing with federal, state and local agencies, and employee access to tax forms. This covers the core of paying both worker types from one platform. missing for 10: explicit documentation of W-2 and 1099 form generation and filing, details on US contractor payment workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed employee/contractor pay runs.
